title: Coverage and documentation
text: Hospitalization claims are approved after verifying the member's policy status, treatment records, hospital discharge summary, and the final invoice. Missing documents are a leading cause of claim delay.

title: Deductible explanation
text: The deductible and co-pay are deducted from the approved claim value before the payout is calculated. Customers should receive a simple explanation of these deductions in plain language.

title: Motor claim repair guidance
text: For motor accidents, the insurer compares the garage estimate with the pre-approval photos and damage records. An itemized invoice is required before final approval.
